description: Claim one claimable reward of your account (list_grants: its id) in its token on Solana, as POST /api/me/grants/:id/claim does, with the checks of a reward paid by transfer: the claim form (method usdc-solana; destination, a Solana wallet; legal_name, country and tax_form only when list_grants' claim.tax_details_required is true, or when this claim reaches the tax reporting threshold, which answers 400 at those fields), the payout pin (when claim.pinned_destination is set, the destination must be it), autopay's switches and the automatic screen (the destination on the sanctions list, the declared country, the automatic cap). Answers its status and the reward: paid in this call (tx_signature, explorer_url), sending (confirming on Solana), or held with its words (the screen held it, or autopay is off or paused): each automatic payout run screens a held reward again and pays it once it passes, and an admin can pay it sooner. A refusal is the route's answer whole: 400 at a field's path, 404 for a reward that is not yours, 409 for one already claimed, expired or withdrawn, 451, the screen's RFC 9457 problem (claim_sanctions, claim_geo) with its checks and fix, nothing filed and the reward still claimable, or 503 while rewards cannot be claimed on this server yet. Signed in only: send your account's API key (an af_ key) as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection; without one it answers 401.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of residence, e.g. US: only when the tax details are asked

destination.description: The Solana wallet (base58) the reward is paid to: one of your wallets (list_grants claim.wallets), or claim.pinned_destination when it is set

id.description: The reward's id (list_grants' grants[].id), one whose status is claimable

legal_name.description: Your legal name: only when the tax details are asked

method.description: usdc-solana, the one method (omitted, it is usdc-solana): the reward is paid on Solana

tax_form.description: W-9 for a US person, W-8BEN for everyone else: only when the tax details are asked

name: claim_grant
title: Claim a reward from make.fun
